_comment: Ko-fi members at the Patron ($100/month) or Featured Sponsor ($300/month) tier. Added automatically from Ko-fi's webhook (each monthly payment lists them until 35 days later - see scripts/kofi-membership.py), or by hand. Key = "kofi-" + a short name. amount = their monthly tier in dollars. url (optional) = the link for their name. until (YYYY-MM-DD) = when to stop listing them; leave it out to list them until you remove them. A Featured Sponsor also needs an entry with the same key in featured-approved.json. Example: "kofi-example": {"name": "Example Exchange", "url": "https://example.com", "amount": 300}
